verdict.rationale: Three.js ships a separate API reference (docs) and a distinct examples gallery of runnable WebGL/WebGPU demos, plus an online editor, but evidence shows these are not integrated into one interactive reference-with-runnable-code experience — docs pages just link out to examples pages, and community feedback calls the official tutorials hard to follow while praising the examples separately. missing for 10: an API reference page with embedded/live runnable code samples per API entry, and independent confirmation that reference and examples are unified rather than separate sites.
